title: potlibc
description: potlibc provides a stable C ABI for all 387 surface versions in the PotLib 2023 deposit. Each handle loads a private in-memory copy of its generated surface plugin, isolating Fortran COMMON and SAVE state without a global lock or an ELF namespace per handle. Every surface provides energy, analytic forces, and a forward-dual Hessian-vector product without materializing the Hessian.
references: Y. Shu, Z. Varga, A. W. Jasper, J. Espinosa-García, J. C. Corchado, and D. G. Truhlar, "PotLib 2023: New version of a potential energy surface library for chemical systems," Mendeley Data, version 1 (2023). https://doi.org/10.17632/chxxhnnt4p.1
